thread:
sam: Heads up — prospect (regulated payments) asked for an explicit onboarding timeline for BYO-HSM + whether CY12 rotation windows are supported. putting SE + security + finance in loop.
tess (SE): got it. do they want a hosted KMS proxy or direct CloudHSM/Vendor-HSM peering? also need target QPS to size encryption proxies.
nora (Legal): procurement wants a short contractual statement clarifying custody of key material and liability for key compromise. can we provide one-liner for the contract and a doc for data room?
diego (Security): we can provide both: an operations runbook for key ceremonies and a contractual statement. question: do they require split knowledge/dual-control for all ceremonies or just initial import?
sam: they said initial onboarding requires dual-control key ceremony; ongoing rotations can be scheduled automated rotations but require two-person approval for manual ops.
tess (SE): tech note: our connector maps customer CMKs to a CustomerKey object. for GCP/azure we support external KMS endpoints; for AWS we support CloudHSM clusters. will include a small terraform example and network diagram.
finance-bot: Pricing policy reminder: BYO-HSM integration = Professional Services onboarding fee + recurring connector fee. Key escrow or managed rotation services are separate billable items.
ops (SRE): quick infra checklist I'll add to runbook:
```text
- Networking: VPC/VNet peering, allowed CIDR to HSM endpoints, MTU tuning
- IAM: least-privilege service account, hardware-backed certs for mutual TLS
- Provisioning: import vs generate-in-HSM flows, key import tool steps
- Ops: rotation cadence, emergency rollback, contact list for dual-control
- Telemetry: KMS audit exports -> SIEM, 90d default retention (adjustable)
```
sam: can we get a ballpark for the quote? procurement needs numbers for budget approval today.
finance-bot: ballpark provided: $15,000 one-time onboarding + $2,500/month connector + $1,500/month for optional managed key-ops (includes quarterly ceremonies). per-10k TPM (transactions per month) beyond baseline may add $500/mo.
tess (SE): that baseline assumes <5k calls/sec. above that we recommend dedicated encryption proxies (additional infra). I'll ask the customer for expected peak TPS.
nora (Legal): draft clause for contract: "Customer retains exclusive control of cryptographic key material; Redwood will not export or persist plaintext key material outside the customer's HSM. Redwood provides operational support only as authorized by Customer." please review with Security.
diego (Security): edit: add audit and access controls: "Redwood will deliver immutable audit logs for all key usage and require documented dual-authorization for any manual key export/import. Audit log retention minimum 1 year; configurable to customer reqs."
tess (SE): adding a short terraform snippet for CloudHSM cluster (to include in the runbook):
```hcl
resource "aws_cloudhsm_v2_cluster" "example" {
  hsm_type = "hsm-type"
  subnet_ids = ["subnet-abc", "subnet-def"]
}
# post-create: initialize cluster and register partition.
```
sam: excellent. timeline: onboarding ceremony + network setup = ~3-5 business days after access approved. manual ceremony slots need customer ops and our SRE.
ops (SRE): note on performance: to avoid KMS call storm during inference we recommend using ephemeral host-local wrapping keys (derived per-host) that are wrapped by the CMK. this reduces KMS QPS; include unwrap backoff guidance in runbook.
finance-bot: also note: key-ops SOW can include scheduled quarterly ceremonies, emergency on-call, and additional audit export retention for extra fee.
nora (Legal): I'll prepare the one-liner and the data-room doc and upload. add a short indemnity note about key compromise modeling (we'll keep it standard).
diego (Security): attach SOC2 link and KMS design doc to data room and include required SIEM integration details.
sam: thanks — let's target uploading the runbook + quote to the data room by COB. I'll schedule a 30m walk-through with prospect security for tomorrow morning.
tess (SE): putting 9:30am on calendar. will demo connector, rotation automation, and per-host wrapping flow.
sam: perfect. tagging everyone for any last follow-ups. :thumbsup:
